name: AmberX notes
author: Brett
description: The AmberX web app's Notes screen on the console (Apps → AmberX → Notes): every amberx-notes@1 note on every device, with search, lists, new / edit / pin / delete (two-step confirm), through control@1 amberx.items / amberx.lists. Deep link console_open("amberx-notes", focus="<list>" | "item:<id>" | "search:<words>" | "new"). REST /api/plugins/amberx-notes (state, settings) and /api/control/amberx.items; MCP amberx-notes_* and amberx_* / control_*; CLI axf amberx-notes … and axf note …; voice "open notes", "new note", "read my inbox".

keeps: /projects/amberx-axf/_data/amberx-notes on axHub: every note, list and to-do (AmberX's own, read and written through control@1)

items.title: The Notes screen's state: settings, every list, the note count and the latest notes
The Notes screen's settings and their defaults
Change Notes screen settings (defaultList, pageSize 10–500, sort updated|created|title, showDone, preview)
Put the Notes screen's settings back to the defaults

items.skip: the page's own control@1 relay: MCP and the CLI call control_* / amberx_* and axf note directly
